source.name: Alaska Department of Fish and Game — 2026-2027 Alaska Hunting Regulations (effective July 1, 2026 - June 30, 2027), unit tables; hunt lists checked against ADF&G Harvest Information RY2025

notes: Over-the-counter options for Alaska: no drawing. Two kinds of rows. (1) huntCode "GEN-<unit>": a general season (harvest ticket, "HT" in the regulations) for that species in that unit or subunit for the 2026-2027 regulatory year; the harvest ticket is free with a hunting license and nonresidents also need a locking tag. A GEN row usually covers only part of the unit, or a short season, or an antler / bag restriction; read the unit table. Matching hunter-success rows are in lib/huntdata/harvest/ak.json (same huntCode, RY2025, split by residency). (2) huntCode = ADF&G registration hunt number (R...): permits issued to anyone who signs up during the stated period (online at hunt.alaska.gov or in person at listed offices or villages), no drawing; some have limited permits, first-come, or "season may be announced" terms. "(residents only)" / "(nonresidents only)" in the label = only that residency may get the permit, read from the regulation rows and checked against RY2025 reports; a label without either means open to both or not confirmed (see research notes). Nonresident rules that apply to every row: Dall sheep, mountain goat (and brown bear) require a licensed guide or a resident relative within the second degree of kindred; nonresident sheep hunters may take one ram every four regulatory years; nonresident moose hunters must complete the Nonresident Moose Hunter Orientation. Drawing (D/Y), Tier II (T), community (C) and targeted (A) hunts are not listed here. tags / applicants and draw stats are null by design.
